text: Competitor X’s strategy of drastic price cuts combined with aggressive digital marketing targeting younger demographics poses a significant threat to our market position. By absorbing short-term losses to gain long-term loyalty, they aim to erode our market share and shift consumer buying patterns. This dual approach of undercutting prices and rebranding through social media could lead to a noticeable decline in our sales figures as customers migrate to the more affordable and digitally engaging competitor.
